instruction: Cinematic wide shot of an indoor dance studio with a wooden ballet barre in the background. On the left, the blonde woman in a black long-sleeve top and leggings (R2) sits in a full split, leaning forward and smiling. On the right, the young girl in a black leotard and white tights (R1) also sits in a full split, smiling back at her. The blonde woman and the young girl face each other, their inner feet nearly touching on the reflective floor. The scene is illuminated by soft, diffused indoor light, creating a cool, neutral color palette with gentle shadows.
